Node arithmetic for S1 over all 37 files (486 nodes) + `tests/scripts/test_residual_drain_happy.py` (3): **301 deleted, 39 moved, 149 kept** (12 kept files unchanged = 128; `test_agent_call` 12; `test_rich_text_seam` 9).

### The prior 13

The prior pass's 13 classifications are applied verbatim; this epic's spec does not restate them. Members the spec names: the 8 `tests/scripts/*_seam_clean_heldout.py` modules (enumeration (2) assigns their handling to this story) and `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/diffing/test_outbound_comments_split_import.py` (bug fuss-chapel-ulna; classified DELETE-WHOLE — its single node is the import-shape pin itself). Their DELETE-BUT-MOVE destinations are the Scope's `tests/unit/test_det_floor_clarity.py`, `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_binding_absence_lifecycle.py`, `tests/interfaces/facades/test_reconciler_last_pass_heldout.py`, `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/orchestrate/test_invariants.py`, `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_config_jira_wiring.py`, `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_rich_text_cutover.py`, `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_wiki_render_hardening.py`, `tests/unit/test_opcert_local_verify_binding.py`, `tests/unit/test_mirror_guard.py`, `tests/unit/review_bot/test_rp04_s5_startup.py`, `tests/unit/grounding/test_harness.py`, `tests/unit/grounding/test_resolve.py`, plus the two new files `tests/unit/test_reconciler_repo_root_c0b9.py` and `tests/unit/test_logging_level.py`. Bug-anchored modules in this story's touch set keep every test function (enumeration (6)): `test_fetcher_split_jql_queries.py` (f6cc-b174-9e9a-435c), `test_access_check_client_seam.py` (2c4b), `test_prompt_repo_root_seam.py` (dc05, whose `_clear_caches` autouse fixture is kept in place).
